boards.title: 全貌与多视角
boards.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: comprehensive art-direction board for the Portal Fitness mobile fitness planet app, not a live app screenshot or production game asset.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND WORLD REFERENCE ONLY. Match its dark graphite presentation, muted natural biome colors, lightly realistic sculpted game terrain, coherent full spherical planet and restrained tech-sport feel. Do not copy its phone UI or data values.
Art language: the environment counterpart to mature urban Western comic characters with lightly realistic proportions. Detailed but curated stylized game art with subtle illustrated contours and broad readable shapes. Natural mature look, friendly exploration, no cuteness. One recognizable continuous globe with a western mountain spine, southeastern river basin, northern ice cap, wide deep teal ocean, greener monsoon coast and a smaller rust-colored arid continent on its far side. Continents must feel organically connected geologically; no pie-slice divisions.
Palette: charcoal #101419 presentation background, graphite #1B2228, slate rocks, warm ochre sandstone, muted forest and sage greens, dusty teal shallow water and deep navy oceans, cool off-white ice. Natural soft directional light with gentle atmospheric rim, restrained highlights, sharp readable terrain, no shiny plastic. Keep visual interest in terrain rather than space ornaments.
Layout: polished landscape 3:2 design-review board, carefully aligned panels, thin subtle separators, large art and limited concise labels. Use English exact labels specified. A small footer "CONCEPT ART • NOT LIVE TERRAIN" on every board. No paragraphs or tiny gibberish annotations.
Avoid: candy pastel clay toy, chibi, neon cyberpunk, exaggerated low-poly spikes, photoreal satellite photograph, random buildings, people, rockets, monsters, glowing holographic grids, dense labels, flat discs, incomplete globe cutouts, four equal territorial wedges.
Primary request: show the finished flourishing planet as one coherent art direction in multiple views.
Composition: title "01 / PLANET IDENTITY". A very large complete globe occupies the left two thirds, upper-right softly lit and lower-left in natural shadow, centered and uncropped. Include realistic readable mountain ranges, flowing river tributaries into estuaries, dense but curated forests, coastal shelf, lakes, north polar glacier, small volcanic island chain; mountains modest relative to planetary radius. On the right stack three smaller complete globes from the SAME planet at different viewpoints: "WESTERN RANGE", "FAR-SIDE COAST", "NORTH POLAR". Each small globe must reveal different geography and show continuity of the same world rather than duplicate the main view. Bottom-left two compact material/lighting strips labeled "NATURAL DAYLIGHT" and "QUIET DUSK": small close landscape views of the same coastline under those lighting conditions. Layout prioritizes beautiful compelling globe art, approximately 80 percent art area. No UI chrome or interface widgets.

Gentle subtle comic-like contour illustration integrated with lightly realistic surfaces. No decorative creatures, no human constructions. All landscapes should be natural, varied and readable, not identical forests.

Keep all five globes full circular and equally prominent. This is a visual progression concept, not a scientific diagram or exact XP unlock rule. No percentage or numeric performance claims.

Title "05 / BODY TO WORLD". Exactly four equally weighted columns, each contains a small simple neutral white metric icon, exact heading, one beautiful large regional landscape and a quiet accent underline.
Column 1 heading "MUSCLE → MOUNTAINS": connected firm mountain ridge with balanced relief, foothills and small patches of snow.
Column 2 "WATER → OCEAN": ocean and natural coastline, freshwater river mouth with varying depth hues.
Column 3 "BONE → POLAR ICE": solid cool-white polar glacier and stone structure with layered ice shelf.
Column 4 "BODY FAT → CLIMATE": balanced biome transition from dry ochre meadow to green seasonal forest, geography remains healthy and dignified, not waste or ugliness.
Below the columns: a large complete thriving globe integrating these four landscapes NATURALLY, not four wedges; two small unobtrusive conceptual feedback snapshots of the same mountain coast showing only slightly richer vegetation and softened atmospheric light, label "GRADUAL VISUAL FEEDBACK".
A clearly legible small note "ART METAPHOR • NO HEALTH SCORE". No numbers, no before-after body photos, no judgement of body size, no medical equipment or scan. The fourth column never depicts toxicity, pollution, decay or punishment. Avoid implying that a data edit scientifically causes instant tectonic change. Do not draw actual app UI.
